rules.keepSimple: value <= 2 OR decisionGap < 35, plus fallback when no form-specific gate clears
rules.software: softwareAdvantage >= 4 AND frequency >= 3 AND buyerClarity >= 3 AND maintenance <= 3

invariants: software is one candidate form, not the default
weak-value or weak-gap ideas stay simple
expert judgment can make service stronger than software
a durable data asset can be the product even when an interface is not
SOFTWARE and COMPANY mean investigate/prototype, not launch
maintenance and buyer clarity remain visible challenges rather than hidden after classification
limitations: not a market-size, ROI, investment, legal, procurement, safety, labor, or technical-feasibility approval
thresholds require domain validation before consequential use
